_help: Messages ambassadors copy with one tap. Edit freely. Placeholders: {link} = their tracked link for that channel, {school} = school name, {name} = ambassador first name. Keep it short and lowercase. Never ask for ratings or reviews here. `daily` is the bank the app's daily reminder draws from: one per day, rotating, with the ambassador's chosen anonymous app on anon days. `anon` means fizz/sidechat/yik yak. Since 2026-11-12 the anonymous posts each lead with ONE of three things the app does, so a week of posts covers all three: it reads everywhere a professor posts about assignments and classes (not only canvas and gradescope deadlines), the tree answers questions about your classes, and the smooth sweeper rings your phone like an alarm before something you haven't turned in is due. Say 'rings' or 'alarm', never 'calls': it is an alarm, not a phone call, and an anonymous app will call out the difference. Don't name ed discussion: it is read at penn only. Some anonymous posts are in a hype voice ("smooth just saved my life", "this new smooth app is crazy"), at Olisa's ask the same day. They are opinions and first-person moments, so the tip beside them tells the ambassador to post the story ones when they are true and to swap in what really happened.

posting_tips: post once per place. if it gets downvoted or removed, let it go. don't repost the same thing.
say it like you'd say it. edit the message so it sounds like you.
the 'saved my life' style posts land when they're true. post them when it actually happens, and swap in what really happened to you.
on anonymous apps, no links in the first post if the app strips them. put 'smooth for students' and people can search it.
if someone asks whether you're involved, say yes, you're an ambassador. honesty does better than hype.
posters only where the campus allows them. check the board's rules first. never over someone else's poster.
reviews: if you like the app, an honest review helps. never ask for stars, never trade anything for a review. apple bans incentivised reviews and it would put the app at risk.
